fields.Brand Customer Promise: Life is better when you get together—convenient, affordable accommodations that make business travel, meetings, celebrations, vacations, and weekend getaways possible.
fields.Brand Value Proposition:
Guests: Get Rest, Get Social, Get Connected, Get a Bite, Get Productive, and Get Fit—premium bedding, bars and lounges, meeting and banquet facilities, restaurants and catering, free Wi-Fi and 24/7 business centers, and fitness or pool amenities.

Owners: Focused-service repositioning for full-service properties; attractive conversion opportunity with one of the lowest costs to franchise in the segment; 300+ hotels globally.

Choice: Award-winning Choice Privileges loyalty and global distribution.
fields.Brand Pillars:
Get together — gatherings for business, events, and leisure.

Focused-service events — equipped for small to medium corporate and social events.

Get Rest / Social / Connected / Productive — core guest experience framework from brand standards.

Conversion opportunity — strategic path from full-service to focused-service operations.
fields.Brand History: Clarion by Choice Hotels operates more than 300 hotels worldwide across the U.S., Europe, Asia, and South America, located near top destinations such as Nashville, New York City, and Atlanta.
fields.Guest Psychographics Description: Travelers who want to combine stays with connection—whether for meetings, celebrations, or getaways—and value dependable amenities, social spaces, and event capability without full-service complexity.
fields.Key Brand Differentiators:
Purpose-built meeting and banquet support for small to medium events.

Social lobby and bar positioning with Get Together brand ethos.

Strong conversion play for owners repositioning full-service assets.

Choice Privileges and global brand distribution.
